_purpose: Map a model identifier to a harness tier. Kept as data, not code, so a new model generation only needs an entry here (F-003 Phase 1).
_matching: Case-insensitive substring match against the model id, rules evaluated in order, first hit wins. Handles 'opus[1m]', 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001', 'claude-sonnet-5', bare 'sonnet'.
_fallback_is_light: Unknown/absent model resolves to light (the FULL weak-model SOP). Under-loading rules is more dangerous than over-loading them (F-003 DEC-3).
